title: TGR-EvoDAG: A DAG-based Multi-Agent Code Evolution Framework for Generative Recommendation on Tencent
abstract: arXiv:2610.32326v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have enabled automated code evolution for algorithm discovery. However, current recursive self-improvement (RSI) research for sequential recommendation faces a dilemma: general-purpose frameworks lack domain-specific feedback, while recommender-specific frameworks rely on linear evolution. Crucially, naively integrating them fails when applied to Generative Recommendation (GR). Unlike end-to-end models, GR relies on a module-cascaded pipeline (tokenization, pre-training, and alignment). In this paradigm, existing evolution methods suffer from: i) cost blindness, squandering budgets by ignoring stage-asymmetric retraining overheads; and ii) short-sighted evaluation, discarding promising upstream innovations that temporarily regress metrics before downstream adaptation. translated_title: TGR-EvoDAG：腾讯面向生成式推荐的基于有向无环图（DAG）的多智能体代码演化框架
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体已经使算法发现中的自动化代码演化成为可能。然而，当前面向序列推荐的递归自我改进（RSI）研究面临一个两难困境：通用框架缺乏领域特定的反馈，而推荐系统专用框架则依赖线性演化。至关重要的是，当应用于生成式推荐（GR）时，简单地将二者整合会遭遇失败。与端到端模型不同，生成式推荐依赖于模块级联的流水线（词元化、预训练与对齐）。在这一范式下，现有的演化方法存在以下问题：i）成本盲视，由于忽视各阶段不对称的再训练开销而浪费预算；ii）短视评估，丢弃了那些在下游适应完成之前暂时导致指标退化的有前景的上游创新。为弥补这些差距，我们提出了TGR-EvoDAG，一个为生成式推荐量身定制的多智能体代码演化框架。TGR-EvoDAG 将代码演化建模为……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TGR-EvoDAG，一个针对腾讯生成式推荐场景的基于DAG的多智能体代码演化框架，通过将代码演化建模为有向无环图而非线性流程，解决了现有方法在模块级联流水线下的成本盲视与短视评估问题，实现更高效的自动化算法发现。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TGR-EvoDAG, a DAG-based multi-agent code evolution framework tailored for Generative Recommendation on Tencent, which models code evolution as a directed acyclic graph rather than a linear process, overcoming cost blindness and short-sighted evaluation in automated algorithm discovery for module-cascaded pipelines.
